convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for BlauTSStochastic custom indicator and includes external .mqh libraries (SmoothAlgorithms.mqh, TradeAlgorithms.mqh) for smoothing algorithms and trade execution logic. Multi-timeframe logic with InpInd_Timeframe parameter.

indicators.name: BlauTSStochastic
indicators.derived_period: min_rates_total = GetStartBars(XLength) + GetStartBars(XLength1) + GetStartBars(XLength2) + GetStartBars(XLength3) + GetStartBars(XLength4) + 3 + SignalBar

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator calculation
derived_values.formula: GetStartBars(XMA_Method,XLength,XPhase) + GetStartBars(XMA_Method,XLength1,XPhase) + GetStartBars(XMA_Method,XLength2,XPhase) + GetStartBars(XMA_Method,XLength3,XPhase) + GetStartBars(XMA_Method,XLength4,XPhase) + 3 + SignalBar

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - chart period in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for trade signal timing

other_exits: Opposite signal closes existing position via BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose when BUY_Close or SELL_Close flags are set

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MM input: positive values = share of deposit in deal (fractional sizing), negative values = fixed lot size. MMMode enum controls lot calculation method (LOT, PCT, etc.)

custom_logic_notes: Three trading modes selected via AlgMode enum: (1) 'breakdown' - histogram crosses zero line using buffer 2; (2) 'twist' - histogram direction change using 3-bar comparison of buffer 2; (3) 'cloudtwist' - signal cloud color change when Up buffer (0) crosses Dn buffer (1). SignalBar input controls which bar is used for signal (0=current, 1=previous completed bar). BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose boolean inputs gate whether each trade action is permitted. Recount flag ensures signal recalculation on data issues.
python_conversion_notes: Custom BlauTSStochastic indicator must be reimplemented in Python using the SmoothAlgorithms.mqh library logic (triple smoothed stochastic with configurable smoothing methods - JJMA, VIDIA, AMA, etc.). The three entry modes (breakdown/twist/cloudtwist) map cleanly to distinct strategy branches. Multi-timeframe support requires resampling OHLC data. Position sizing uses conditional logic: negative MM = fixed lots, positive MM = deposit fraction. TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, LoadHistory, CIsNewBar) must be reimplemented. No digit adjustment detected - SL/TP in points used directly.
